title: BaxtyBoi's Commands
description: A few commands to help you in your daily MC life
body:
### ABOUT THIS MOD
this mod was made when I wanted a few helpful commands for minecraft. It was made in MCreator 2026.1



### WHAT IT ADDS 
This mod ads many commands
- the commands:
- /spin <Target> <speed> <rotations> rotates a player
- /carrots Gives player many carrots (an easter egg of sorts)
- /overworld Tp's player to Overworld
- /end TP's player to end
- /nether Tp's player to end
- /realtime Will give you the real time and date of day IRL
- /switchchest will switch a barrel or shulker or pot below you to a chest and keep - - - the items in it
- /switchbarrel will switch a chest or shulker or pot below you to a barrel and keep - the items in it
- /fallbedrock will summon a falling bedrock above one's head
- /fireball will, well, shoot a fireball
- /nothing is nothing! (Big suprise there)
- /creative
- /survival
- /adventure
- /spectator (all change to respective gamemodes)
- /fakecreeper (creates fake creeper sound a explosion)
- /fullheal (sets hunger and health to max
- /getdata (sends to chat the data for the block below the player)
- /cats this command has a 1/100 chance of exploding when used. Be Careful!
